experience_description: Located in the heart of Ocean City - Hanoi's vibrant new "East Side", Mega Grand World is expected to become a must-visit attraction on the northern tourism map.
Mega Grand World offers many advantages by meeting all visitor needs, including easy transportation, 24/7 entertainment and relaxation in a shopping space with exciting experiences.
Convenient Transportation

Situated at the intersection of Vinhomes Ocean Park 2 and Vinhomes Ocean Park 3 within Ocean City, Mega Grand World Hanoi is built and developed to become a new and attractive destination in the North.

Currently, the investor is deploying VinBus shuttle services connecting various points from Hanoi to Ocean City. In the future, the investor plans to add more free VinBus routes to transport visitors from the city center to Mega Grand World Hanoi.

Specifically, these bus routes have a frequency of one trip every 10 minutes, operating day and night, seven days a week. Therefore, tens of millions of visitors can conveniently travel to and from Mega Grand World Hanoi for entertainment, shopping, and dining without worrying much about transportation methods and distances.

Comprising two "quarters" in the architectural styles of Venice (Italy) and K-Town (Korea), Mega Grand World Hanoi gathers over 800 businesses, operating in all sectors from cuisine, shopping, entertainment, to cultural and artistic experiences...

All trendy domestic and international brands can be found here, offering visitors an attractive experiential journey. Coupled with the adjacent Royal Wave Park and Paradise Bay, and a host of new exciting rides like Sky Drop, Magic Bike, Balloon Tower... by VinWonders, Mega Grand World Hanoi provides numerous entertainment options for people in the North.

A representative of the investor stated that at Mega Grand World, visitors can experience thrilling games, admire international art, enjoy sports, and immerse themselves in street festivals. "Most notably, everything is right in Hanoi's new East Side. Every hour, every 10 minutes, there's a Vinbus to pick up and drop off visitors," they said.
A Hub for Events and Festivals
Mega Grand World Hanoi is built within the overall "destination city" Ocean City with iconic architecture.

In the Venice subdivision, hundreds of brightly colored shops line the river, recreating the bustling Italian water town scene – a vibrant trading hub. Moreover, classic European culture is imprinted on decorative elements like fountains, flower gardens, seating, whimsical sculptures, and grand squares.

Meanwhile, the K-Town subdivision, with styles reminiscent of Gangnam, Itaewon cultural streets, Hongdae's culinary and art streets, as well as Myeongdong's fashion and cosmetic shopping area, recreates a modern yet traditional Korea.

Within this space of culture, festivals, shopping, and entertainment, visitors can cruise on the famous Gondola boats along the 830m long canal in Venice. Here, people can not only admire the magnificent and romantic scenery along with the architecture of the houses lining the canal banks but also enjoy impromptu European music and join the lively atmosphere of festivals on both sides.

According to the investor, the highlight of the Venice river is the interactive live-action show on the river called "The Grand Voyage," which recreates the bustling East-West trade scene and the journey of discovery to the prosperous Mega Grand World trading port. Combined with light shows, water music, 3D mapping technology, and music, The Grand Voyage offers an artistic feast for visitors, promising to be an attractive artistic show for domestic and international tourists visiting Hanoi.

With the above advantages, Mega Grand Hanoi will become a festival destination with international-class activities and events such as International Culture Day, Korean Street Food Festival, Ravolution Music Festival (attracting tens of thousands of music lovers), and European Street Carnival... Young people can enjoy vibrant music performances by famous DJs, explore the unique cultural characteristics of different countries through exhibition and sale booths of traditional products.
Multi-Experience Destination

Coming to Mega Grand World, residents of Hanoi and northern provinces can freely enjoy 24/7 entertainment, leisure, and shopping. While children can enjoy exciting activities at museums and play complexes, teenagers and young adults have access to workshop streets, accessory stores, fashion boutiques, or thrilling challenges with VinWonders games located at Mega Grand World and the Wave Park.

Fashion, cosmetic brands, massage services, beauty salons, and aesthetic clinics will offer unique shopping and care experiences for both women and men. Seniors will also find suitable options with culinary streets, specialized shopping stores for the elderly, and Eastern-Western medicine health centers... Shopping activities will be more complete when combined with cultural, entertainment, and festival experiences.

With increasingly easy and convenient transportation, along with meticulously invested facilities, Mega Grand World Hanoi promises to become a vibrant entertainment and shopping destination in the North, offering not only many attractive stores and shops but also a park system with numerous exciting games and spectacular festival performances, attracting tourists from all regions and all ages.
